purpose: Fresh before/after public PPTX workflow and allocation trial for the Scene::Scanner::scan direct Reader/NamespaceResolver candidate.

candidate.name: scene-scanner-direct-reader
candidate.mechanism: Replace the NsReader wrapper and resolve_event transport in Scene::Scanner::scan with Reader plus NamespaceResolver, preserving exact pending-pop timing, namespace scope transitions, event/error mapping, limits, and refusal order.
candidate.oracle_scope: The candidate review must retain or add a cfg(test) differential/refusal oracle in the allowlisted file; it is reviewed before application.

synthetic.source_contract: sealed change-0813 probe corpus and timed bodies, with the current process-wide live-byte conservation test fix in counting_allocator.rs and only the materialized local dependency path in Cargo.toml

real.source_contract: packet-local copy of the admitted change-0822 real-file probe; no production or harness dependency

qualification.purpose: Observer-only semantic and refusal qualification before timed comparisons; no timing decision is made from this lane.

native.rss: maximum resident set size in KiB from /usr/bin/time

allocation.rss: maximum resident set size in KiB from /usr/bin/time

codegen.purpose: Exact native-binary nm and objdump evidence after all workload lanes are terminal and before cleanup; verify compiled event-wrapper call sites in Scene::read_with, which contains the inlined scanner.
checks: exact demangled owner symbol and size
NsReader::process_event and resolve_event callsite disposition recorded
no claim beyond static mechanism evidence

policy.eligible_benefit_cases: All twelve synthetic commit/lifecycle rows plus the real/direct row; synthetic capture rows are retained as negative controls because the timed capture may precede Scene::Scanner::scan.
policy.benefit_gate: At least one eligible representative public workflow has median after/before <= 0.97 and bootstrap upper endpoint < 1.00.
policy.latency_veto: Any of all nineteen measured rows with bootstrap lower endpoint > 1.05 vetoes adoption.
policy.allocation_gate: Paired allocation medians must not increase calls, allocated bytes, net live bytes, or peak above entry.
policy.rss_review: A paired process-RSS increase above 5 percent requires explicit review; RSS is diagnostic and cannot establish a memory saving.
policy.claims: No universal, cross-format, cold-cache, tail-latency, RSS, or historical speedup claim.
